project.title: wastewater metagenome Metagenome
project.description: This project aimed at assessing variations on the composition of bacterial communities inhabiting treated effluents of urban wastewater treatement plants (WWTP) upon ozonation and direct storage of the ozonated water. In addition, it aimed as assessing if the major taxa surviving storage could also survive in a pristine environment (sterile mineral water). The data obtained would permit to conclude if the presence of ozonation by-products are relevant for the selection of the surviving bacteria, or not.
project.center_name: Laboratory for Process Engineering, Environment, Biotechnology and Energy
